mapper.update: UPDATE product SET category_id=#{categoryId},name=#{name},brand=#{brand},description=#{description},updated_at=#{now} WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND id=#{productId}
UPDATE product SET status=#{target},updated_at=#{now} WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND id=#{productId} AND status=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM product WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND id=#{productId}
